items.title: 68251_Teddy McRae oral history interview
items.q: So gentle to go on the stage with him and work with him.

ctx.x: All the things they used to say about him, I found out he was -- the man had a wonderful soul. Beautiful man to be around.

So gentle to go on the stage with him and work with him. He might've been loud offstage when he got up to Harlem, you know, "I'm Oh, Bill Robinsonson." But to work with this man, you'll love small sweet kid him. He's just a good smoother like a {inaudible}. He was just a beautiful guy.
